title: arenaria lanuginosa subsp. saxosa
intro: Arenaria lanuginosa subsp. saxosa, commonly known as woolly sandwort, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a candidate for treating various conditions such as wounds, infections, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of woolly sandwort are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of woolly sandwort and its potential applications in medicine.
